description: This file provides utility functions for making API GET requests, including URL resolution, handling organization ID injection, and logging. It acts as a centralized helper for frontend API interactions, abstracting fetch calls with URL construction and error handling.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests, using window location, environment variables, or defaults to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a relative path, properly handling the /api segment and absolute URLs.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl
methods.description: Appends organization_id query parameter to URL if missing and organization ID is available.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path or URL, handling URL construction, organization ID injection, headers, and parsing the response.
